mode: exploration, not confirmation; newly authorized by user's request to try unconventional ideas/combinations
first_question: Does preserving prefix dynamics or combining continuous and discrete supervision help source-person transfer beyond a conventional summary baseline?
data: Original train34 people/1442rows only. Existing dev/test labels must not be read or hashed. Existing target Y9/prefix_states/quantile thresholds are NOT reused for fold labels.
folds: 3 deterministic cohort-stratified participant folds, SHA256(seed20261102,participant) ordering and round-robin within cohort; labels never used in split
fold_preprocessing: Refit valid training target .25/.5/.75 quantiles, prefix states, participant-weighted Markov prior, summary and sequence standardization, and log1p continuous-target scaling on inner training only. Held labels are used for scoring only after training.
sequence: 96x4 prefix frame descriptors: voiced pitch cents, power dBFS, periodicity, voiced mask. Frozen 50ms ACF/RMS descriptor,10ms hop,cut raw waveform at1second before extraction. No new audio-model download.
hypotheses: 60 summaries may lose predictive temporal order; compare ordered TCN with identical TCN whose per-record frame order is randomly permuted by a fixed label-blind source-ID hash

Continuous future descriptors may provide denser supervision than nine quantile labels; compare same ordered TCN with finite10-pattern head versus guard-aware two-component diagonal Gaussian MDN on standardized log1p descriptors, truncated at physical descriptor0, plus marginal BCE
Temporal/continuous combinations must beat strong conventional controls; modern model names alone are not novelty
neural_training: CPU1thread;fixed30epochs,no early stop/tuning. Equal total weight per training person. Ordered/shuffled joint use identical architecture/init/batches; shuffling preserves each row's multiset/cross-channel values but changes order. It is a topology/order control, not proof every representation difference is pure time information.
primary: held-source-person macro mean9rule BCE,clip1e-6,allrows including invalidfutureguard,eachperson scored once across folds
promotion: Promising exploratory result requires>=2percent relative improvement against Markov and HGB and direction in>=2of3folds. No statistical confirmation or novelty claim. If no candidate passes, preserve negative firstbatch and reconsider representation/data-information hypotheses before any separately planned batch.
scope_limitations: All source participants historically exposed; new folds do not remove adaptive selection bias
one seed/pilotsetting cannot establish neural model superiority
TCN/MDN combinations are hypotheses not new algorithms
